name: Thor Hammer Time

features.name: Lightning Bonus
features.description: Multipliers, sticky wilds or wild reels.

review:
Thor Hammer Time is a 5x3 Norse slot from Nolimit City's gentler early days. Thor's Lightning Bonus symbol on reel 5 awards a multiplier, random sticky wilds or sticky wild reels.

Rune Raze randomly turns every rune into one type, and Hammer Time turns all the high symbols into Thor. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 2,328x cap and a 33% hit rate.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
